name: Suzuki
source:
Suzuki is a corporate coworker of Kazuki. While she may appear meek and submissive, Suzuki has an immoral side that has occasionally gotten others in serious trouble. She has always held a secret desire for Kazuki, and those feelings have grown even stronger since his dual marriage.

[From an [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070210175448/www.elizar.com/?p=29]old review[/url] by Nargrakhan]
